jobs.title: Site Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

**Job Title**: Site Engineer

**Location:** Aberdeen

**Project Type:** Civils / Energy

**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group

Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.

The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.

Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.

By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  

* Ensure all works are delivered safely and in accordance with Balfour Beatty and SSEN health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Manage and supervise day-to-day site activities across earthworks, drainage, roads, ducting, foundations and utility installations.
* Set out works accurately in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and project tolerances.
* Conduct site surveys and maintain survey control points throughout construction.
* Review construction drawings and technical information, identifying and resolving engineering issues before works commence.
* Produce and maintain quality records, inspection test plans (ITPs), check sheets and as-built documentation.
* Monitor subcontractor performance to ensure compliance with programme, quality and safety requirements.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil, HVDC, substation, cable and building work packages.
* Manage permits, temporary works requirements and engineering compliance on site.
* Assist with short-term planning and ensure work activities are delivered in line with the project programme.
* Identify and implement productivity improvements and value engineering opportunities.
* Maintain accurate daily records, site diaries and progress reports.
* Support commercial teams through measurement of completed works and validation of subcontractor claims.
* Ensure environmental controls are implemented, particularly regarding drainage, water management, protected species and ecological constraints.
* Participate in site inspections, audits and client progress meetings.
* Raise and close out NCRs, defects and quality issues in a timely manner.
* Coordinate material deliveries, plant requirements and logistics activities to maintain efficient site operations.
* Support testing and commissioning activities associated with substations, cable routes and associated infrastructure.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with SSEN, designers, subcontractors and local stakeholders.
* Mentor graduate and assistant engineers, promoting best practice and engineering excellence.

 **Who we're looking for**  

* Degree, HNC, HND or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Valid CSCS card (Academically or Professionally Qualified Person).
* Full UK driving licence
* Previous experience working as a Site Engineer on major infrastructure, transmission, power, energy, highways or civil engineering projects.
* Experience of setting out earthworks, roads, drainage, reinforced concrete and utility installations.
* Knowledge of quality assurance processes, Inspection Test Plans (ITPs) and completion documentation.
* Experience managing subcontractors and coordinating multiple work fronts.
* Familiarity with NEC contracts and collaborative delivery environments.
* Experience working within strict health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Previous involvement in substation, HVDC, overhead line or utility infrastructure projects would be advantageous given the project scope.

 **Why work for us**

**Professional & Personal Development**

The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.

We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.

We're also very proud of our Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified.

* Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low-carbon future.
* Work on challenging, high-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi-disciplinary team.
* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.
* Enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

**For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland - You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section**

 **About us**

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.

We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.

Our award-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.

**Diversity and inclusion**

At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion

To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/

We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com

* Develop, test, and maintain .NET backend services and React UIs for assessment platforms.
* Integrate cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure, Terraform, and Docker.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Optimise application performance and resolve incidents rapidly.
* Mentor peers, review code, and drive best practices in software development.
* Support production deployments and provide technical input during key project phases.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

* .NET (C#), React, API Management, Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure), DevOps, Data Security, Software Design (Intermediate)
* Collaboration, Problem Solving, Technical Acumen, Adaptability, Innovation (Intermediate)
* Ethical Responsibility (Effective proficiency)
* Learning to Learn, Artificial Intelligence (Intermediate)

* Proven experience delivering .NET and React solutions in production.
* Hands-on with cloud platforms, CI/CD, and secure coding.

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**About us**

ebiscon is a software development and IT consulting company with offices in Cologne and Athens. We analyse our customers' business processes and develop tailor-made digital solutions for them – web and mobile applications, cloud services on Microsoft Azure, e-commerce solutions with Shopware and Salesforce solutions.

Most of our customers are mid-size companies in Germany, from industries such as e-commerce, retail, laboratory supply and e-mobility. We support them from the first idea through development to ongoing operation, and often work with them for many years. In addition, we develop our own software platform for the e-mobility market.

**Your role**

You will mainly work for one of our key customers: a leading European group in laboratory supply and wholesale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you take ownership of your topics: from understanding the requirement to a solution that runs reliably in production. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to do next – you drive your topics forward, make decisions within your area and stand behind the result. From time to time, you will also support our own e-mobility platform.

We work AI-first. Most of our code is no longer written by hand but generated with AI coding agents such as Claude Code – based on clear specifications and verified by you before it goes live. Your value lies less in typing code than in understanding the problem, steering the AI precisely and judging whether the result is correct, secure and maintainable.

**Your responsibilities**

* Take full responsibility for your topics – from the requirement to production and beyond
* Understand the business processes behind a requirement and raise questions or concerns early
* Turn requirements into clear specifications and implement them with AI coding agents
* Review AI-generated code thoroughly – security, authorization, data exposure, error handling – and only merge what you fully understand
* Design backend services, APIs and integrations with C# / .NET, e.g. between e-commerce, ERP and logistics systems
* Estimate and commit to your tasks in grooming and deliver them reliably – and speak up early if a commitment is at risk
* Present your results in the regular reviews with the project team and the customer
* Take part in code reviews and work according to our engineering standards (clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development)
* Keep technical documentation up to date and support releases

**Your profile**

* At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
* Experience in building and operating production systems
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as your primary way of developing – and a clear sense of where not to trust them
* You take ownership: you have driven topics independently and are used to being accountable for the result
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server) and REST APIs
* Experience with integrating third-party systems such as ERP, PIM or logistics systems
* Good understanding of automated testing, CI/CD and secure software development
* Experience with Docker and cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure
* Ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people
* Structured, independent way of working and clear written communication
* Fluent English; German is a plus

**Nice to have**

* Experience with B2B e-commerce, wholesale or order management processes
* Shopware experience
* Experience in an IT services or agency environment
* Salesforce integrations
* Azure certifications
* Front-end experience with a modern framework

**Working model**

* Hybrid work in Athens
* Agreed core hours for team and customer meetings
* Occasional travel to Cologne, e.g. for project kick-offs

**What we offer**

* Long-term work for a key customer, with real influence on their systems
* A high degree of responsibility and direct contact with the management
* Flexible working hours
* Monthly meal vouchers
* Annual learning budget for training, certifications and AI tools

**How to apply**

Please apply via Indeed or send your CV together with your salary expectations and notice period to career@ebiscon.de.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: Up to 60,000.00€ per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Αθήνα

jobs.title: React Software Engineer - Barcelona - (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**We are:**  
Wizeline, a global AI-centric technology solutions provider, develops cutting-edge, **AI-powered** digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of **growth, collaboration,** and **impact.**  
  
**With the right people and the right ideas, there's no limit to what we can achieve**

  

**Are you a fit?**  
Sounds awesome, right? Now, let's make sure you're a good fit for the role:

  

***Must-have Skills***

To be successful in this role, you must have:

* Core Principles: Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
* Frontend: Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and styling using Emotion.
* Backend & APIs: Proven experience with Node.js and GraphQL, alongside working knowledge of C# and Microsoft .NET.
* Build & Deployment Tools: Familiarity with Artifactory for dependency and artifact management.
* Adaptability to work across varied tech stacks and architecture patterns.
* Strong focus on writing clean, tested, and well-documented code.
* Strong architecture skills, with the ability to select the best stack for each project.
* Strong communication skills in English.
* Experience in one or more of the most commonly used web applications stacks.

***Nice-to-have Skills***

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject.
* Experience working directly with clients.
* Hands-on knowledge of working in an Agile environment.
* Experience with the latest and greatest web standards, including HTML5 and CSS3.
* Strong sense of web design, fundamentals of user experience, and an understanding of accessibility principles.
* Holistic experience with the web stack, including protocols and web server optimization techniques.
* A code repository you can share with the team, showcasing your contributions to open source projects is a plus.

### **Nice-to-have**

* **AI Tooling Proficiency:** Leverage one or more AI tools to optimize and augment day-to-day work, including drafting, analysis, research, or process automation. Provide recommendations on effective AI use and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation & total rewards
* Health benefits & wellness programs
* Savings & retirement plans
* Global mobility opportunities
* Flexible work policy and remote-friendly approach
* Happy hours, gaming tournaments, sports activities & more
* Continuous learning & training programs with WizeAcademy
* Free certifications in cloud technologies and coding languages

  

Find out more about our culture here.
